source: Amal's notes, Google Doc "Mahdi's Grammar Rules notes" (edited 2026-09-30), applied 2026-09-30
what: Amal's 11 new notes change rule wording only. Every recorded correction under those rules was read against her note: 0 dropped, 0 added. Rows not listed in read_and_kept were read too and are untouched by the notes (e.g. D1 preposition choices, E1 duals).

notes.C4b: after abel it is always abel ma + present, no b-, even for a past meaning (abel ma aaji = before I came)
notes.C5: willa is another 'or'; the recorded slip is aw vs willa; wala ana = neither do I
notes.C6: conditionals need bikoon before an adjective or biddi / 3indi; lamma drops the b-, iza keeps it
notes.C7: no el, no illi: an indefinite word takes no illi (aktar ishi ba7ebbo, fi u8niyye ba3rafha)
notes.C8: addaish and kam both = how much / many; kam always takes the singular; kam also = few
notes.D1: see her Doc 'Arabic Materials' for more
notes.D3: all prepositions take endings except bi; la-: ili, ilak...; fi: fiyy, fik...
notes.E1: 3-10: the number without its -e/-a ending + the plural noun (5ames da2aaye2)
notes.E2: tult = 20 past (talaat u tult = 3:20); illa also = except
notes.F3: the card explains causative verbs (doubled middle, n-, t-) instead of shadda
